name: scrum-master-toolkit
description: Scrum-vocabulary MCP server. Provides 14 tools for backlog management, sprint tracking, impediment logging, and burndown reporting.

github_token.title: GitHub Token
github_token.description: Personal access token with read/write access to the project (repo + project scopes).

config_path.title: Scrum Config Location
config_path.description: Path or URL to your project's scrum config file. Accepts a local path (e.g. /Users/you/myproject/.github/scrum/config.yml), a relative path (e.g. ./scrum.yml), or an https:// URL to a remote config. The project root is declared in the config file itself via project.projRoot (relative to the config file's directory).
